## 主题配色预览页

```html
<!-- Generated by Trae Work -->
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="zh-CN">
  <head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8" />
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0" />
    <title>中式传统色彩 · 10套UI配色方案</title>
    <style>
      @font-face {
        font-family: "CrimsonPro";
        src: url("./_shared/fonts/CrimsonPro-Regular.ttf") format("truetype");
        font-weight: 400;
      }
      @font-face {
        font-family: "CrimsonPro";
        src: url("./_shared/fonts/CrimsonPro-Bold.ttf") format("truetype");
        font-weight: 700;
      }
      @font-face {
        font-family: "WorkSans";
        src: url("./_shared/fonts/WorkSans-Regular.ttf") format("truetype");
        font-weight: 400;
      }
      @font-face {
        font-family: "WorkSans";
        src: url("./_shared/fonts/WorkSans-Bold.ttf") format("truetype");
        font-weight: 700;
      }

      *,
      *::before,
      *::after {
        box-sizing: border-box;
        margin: 0;
        padding: 0;
      }
      html {
        font-size: 16px;
        scroll-behavior: smooth;
      }
      body {
        font-family: "WorkSans", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif;
        line-height: 1.7;
        min-height: 100vh;
        transition:
          background-color 0.4s,
          color 0.4s;
      }

      .container {
        max-width: 1100px;
        margin: 0 auto;
        padding: 2rem 1.5rem 4rem;
      }

      /* ===== 主题切换按钮 ===== */
      .theme-switcher {
        display: flex;
        flex-wrap: wrap;
        gap: 0.5rem;
        justify-content: center;
        margin-bottom: 2rem;
      }
      .theme-btn {
        padding: 0.5rem 1rem;
        border: 2px solid var(--border);
        background: var(--bg-card);
        color: var(--ink-primary);
        font-family: inherit;
        font-size: 0.82rem;
        font-weight: 600;
        border-radius: 8px;
        cursor: pointer;
        transition: all 0.2s;
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        gap: 0.35rem;
      }
      .theme-btn:hover {
        border-color: var(--primary);
        transform: translateY(-1px);
      }
      .theme-btn.active {
        background: var(--primary);
        color: var(--ink-inverse);
        border-color: var(--primary);
      }
      .theme-dot {
        width: 10px;
        height: 10px;
        border-radius: 50%;
        flex-shrink: 0;
      }

      /* ===== 头部 ===== */
      .site-header {
        text-align: center;
        padding: 2rem 0 1.5rem;
        margin-bottom: 1.5rem;
      }
      .site-header h1 {
        font-family: "CrimsonPro", serif;
        font-size: 2.1rem;
        font-weight: 700;
        margin-bottom: 0.4rem;
        letter-spacing: 0.04em;
      }
      .site-header p {
        color: var(--ink-secondary);
        font-size: 0.95rem;
        max-width: 600px;
        margin: 0 auto;
      }

      /* ===== 区块 ===== */
      .section {
        margin-bottom: 2.5rem;
      }
      .section-title {
        font-family: "CrimsonPro", serif;
        font-size: 1.35rem;
        font-weight: 700;
        margin-bottom: 1rem;
        color: var(--ink-primary);
        padding-bottom: 0.4rem;
        border-bottom: 2px solid var(--divider);
      }

      /* ===== 色卡 ===== */
      .palette-grid {
        display: grid;
        grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(150px, 1fr));
        gap: 0.75rem;
        margin-bottom: 1.5rem;
      }
      .color-card {
        border-radius: 8px;
        overflow: hidden;
        box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
        border: 1px solid var(--border-light);
        transition: transform 0.2s;
      }
      .color-card:hover {
        transform: translateY(-2px);
      }
      .color-swatch {
        height: 70px;
        width: 100%;
      }
      .color-info {
        padding: 0.6rem 0.8rem;
        background: var(--bg-card);
      }
      .color-name {
        font-weight: 600;
        font-size: 0.82rem;
      }
      .color-hex {
        font-family: "GeistMono", monospace;
        font-size: 0.75rem;
        color: var(--ink-tertiary);
      }
      .color-role {
        font-size: 0.7rem;
        color: var(--ink-secondary);
        margin-top: 0.15rem;
        padding: 1px 5px;
        background: var(--bg-overlay);
        border-radius: 3px;
        display: inline-block;
      }

      /* ===== 组件 ===== */
      .showcase {
        background: var(--bg-card);
        border-radius: 12px;
        padding: 1.5rem;
        margin-bottom: 1.5rem;
        border: 1px solid var(--border-light);
        box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
      }
      .showcase-label {
        font-size: 0.75rem;
        font-weight: 600;
        color: var(--ink-tertiary);
        text-transform: uppercase;
        letter-spacing: 0.08em;
        margin-bottom: 0.8rem;
      }

      /* 按钮 */
      .btn-group {
        display: flex;
        flex-wrap: wrap;
        gap: 0.6rem;
        margin-bottom: 1rem;
      }
      .btn {
        padding: 0.55rem 1.2rem;
        border-radius: 6px;
        font-family: inherit;
        font-size: 0.85rem;
        font-weight: 600;
        cursor: pointer;
        transition: all 0.2s;
        border: 2px solid transparent;
        display: inline-flex;
        align-items: center;
        gap: 0.3rem;
      }
      .btn:active {
        transform: scale(0.97);
      }
      .btn-primary {
        background: var(--accent);
        color: #fff;
        border-color: var(--accent);
      }
      .btn-primary:hover {
        background: var(--accent-hover);
        box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.12);
      }
      .btn-secondary {
        background: transparent;
        color: var(--accent);
        border-color: var(--accent);
      }
      .btn-secondary:hover {
        background: var(--accent-light);
      }
      .btn-solid {
        background: var(--primary);
        color: var(--ink-inverse);
        border-color: var(--primary);
      }
      .btn-solid:hover {
        background: var(--primary-hover);
      }
      .btn-ghost {
        background: transparent;
        color: var(--ink-secondary);
        border-color: var(--border);
      }
      .btn-ghost:hover {
        background: var(--bg-overlay);
        border-color: var(--ink-tertiary);
      }
      .btn-success {
        background: var(--success);
        color: #fff;
        border-color: var(--success);
      }
      .btn-warning {
        background: var(--warning);
        color: var(--ink-primary);
        border-color: var(--warning);
      }
      .btn-danger {
        background: var(--danger);
        color: #fff;
        border-color: var(--danger);
      }
      .btn-disabled {
        opacity: 0.45;
        cursor: not-allowed;
        background: var(--bg-elevated);
        color: var(--ink-tertiary);
        border-color: var(--border);
      }
      .btn-sm {
        padding: 0.35rem 0.85rem;
        font-size: 0.78rem;
      }
      .btn-lg {
        padding: 0.75rem 1.8rem;
        font-size: 0.95rem;
      }

      /* 导航栏 */
      .navbar {
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        justify-content: space-between;
        padding: 0.85rem 1.2rem;
        background: var(--primary);
        color: var(--ink-inverse);
        border-radius: 6px;
        margin-bottom: 1rem;
      }
      .navbar-brand {
        font-family: "CrimsonPro", serif;
        font-size: 1.15rem;
        font-weight: 700;
      }
      .navbar-links {
        display: flex;
        gap: 1.2rem;
        list-style: none;
      }
      .navbar-links a {
        color: var(--ink-inverse);
        text-decoration: none;
        font-size: 0.85rem;
        opacity: 0.85;
        transition: opacity 0.2s;
      }
      .navbar-links a:hover {
        opacity: 1;
        text-decoration: underline;
      }

      /* 排版 */
      .type-demo h1 {
        font-family: "CrimsonPro", serif;
        font-size: 1.8rem;
        margin-bottom: 0.4rem;
      }
      .type-demo h2 {
        font-family: "CrimsonPro", serif;
        font-size: 1.35rem;
        margin-bottom: 0.35rem;
        color: var(--ink-primary);
      }
      .type-demo h3 {
        font-size: 1.05rem;
        margin-bottom: 0.35rem;
        color: var(--ink-secondary);
      }
      .type-demo p {
        color: var(--ink-secondary);
        margin-bottom: 0.6rem;
        font-size: 0.9rem;
      }
      .text-muted {
        color: var(--ink-tertiary);
      }
      .text-accent {
        color: var(--accent);
        font-weight: 600;
      }
      .text-link {
        color: var(--accent);
        text-decoration: underline;
        text-underline-offset: 2px;
      }

      /* 卡片 */
      .card-grid {
        display: grid;
        grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(240px, 1fr));
        gap: 1rem;
      }
      .card {
        background: var(--bg-elevated);
        border-radius: 8px;
        padding: 1.2rem;
        border: 1px solid var(--border-light);
        transition: box-shadow 0.2s;
      }
      .card:hover {
        box-shadow: var(--shadow-md);
      }
      .card-title {
        font-family: "CrimsonPro", serif;
        font-size: 1.05rem;
        font-weight: 700;
        margin-bottom: 0.4rem;
      }
      .card-text {
        font-size: 0.85rem;
        color: var(--ink-secondary);
        line-height: 1.55;
      }
      .card-meta {
        margin-top: 0.8rem;
        padding-top: 0.6rem;
        border-top: 1px solid var(--divider);
        font-size: 0.75rem;
        color: var(--ink-tertiary);
        display: flex;
        justify-content: space-between;
      }

      /* 表单 */
      .form-row {
        display: grid;
        grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
        gap: 0.8rem;
        margin-bottom: 0.8rem;
      }
      .form-group {
        margin-bottom: 0.8rem;
      }
      .form-label {
        display: block;
        font-size: 0.82rem;
        font-weight: 600;
        color: var(--ink-primary);
        margin-bottom: 0.3rem;
      }
      .form-input {
        width: 100%;
        padding: 0.55rem 0.85rem;
        border: 2px solid var(--border);
        border-radius: 6px;
        background: var(--bg-page);
        color: var(--ink-primary);
        font-family: inherit;
        font-size: 0.85rem;
        transition:
          border-color 0.2s,
          box-shadow 0.2s;
      }
      .form-input::placeholder {
        color: var(--ink-tertiary);
      }
      .form-input:focus {
        outline: none;
        border-color: var(--accent);
        box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px var(--accent-light);
      }

      /* 标签 */
      .badge-group {
        display: flex;
        flex-wrap: wrap;
        gap: 0.4rem;
      }
      .badge {
        padding: 0.2rem 0.6rem;
        border-radius: 100px;
        font-size: 0.78rem;
        font-weight: 600;
        display: inline-flex;
        align-items: center;
        gap: 0.25rem;
      }
      .badge-primary {
        background: var(--accent-light);
        color: var(--accent);
      }
      .badge-success {
        background: var(--success-bg);
        color: var(--success);
      }
      .badge-warning {
        background: var(--warning-bg);
        color: var(--warning-text, #8c6a2e);
      }
      .badge-danger {
        background: var(--danger-bg);
        color: var(--danger);
      }
      .badge-info {
        background: var(--info-bg);
        color: var(--info);
      }
      .badge-ghost {
        background: transparent;
        border: 1px solid var(--border);
        color: var(--ink-secondary);
      }

      /* 警告 */
      .alert {
        padding: 0.85rem 1rem;
        border-radius: 6px;
        border-left: 4px solid;
        margin-bottom: 0.6rem;
        font-size: 0.85rem;
        display: flex;
        align-items: flex-start;
        gap: 0.6rem;
      }
      .alert-success {
        background: var(--success-bg);
        border-color: var(--success);
        color: var(--ink-primary);
      }
      .alert-warning {
        background: var(--warning-bg);
        border-color: var(--warning);
        color: var(--ink-primary);
      }
      .alert-danger {
        background: var(--danger-bg);
        border-color: var(--danger);
        color: var(--ink-primary);
      }
      .alert-info {
        background: var(--info-bg);
        border-color: var(--info);
        color: var(--ink-primary);
      }
      .alert-icon {
        font-size: 1rem;
        line-height: 1;
        flex-shrink: 0;
      }

      /* 分割线 */
      .divider-line {
        border: none;
        border-top: 1px solid var(--divider);
        margin: 0.6rem 0;
      }
      .divider-dashed {
        border: none;
        border-top: 2px dashed var(--border);
        margin: 0.6rem 0;
      }
      .divider-label {
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        gap: 0.8rem;
        color: var(--ink-tertiary);
        font-size: 0.78rem;
        font-weight: 600;
      }
      .divider-label::before,
      .divider-label::after {
        content: "";
        flex: 1;
        border-top: 1px solid var(--divider);
      }

      /* 表格 */
      .table-wrap {
        overflow-x: auto;
        max-height: 400px;
      }
      table {
        width: 100%;
        border-collapse: collapse;
        font-size: 0.85rem;
        min-width: 460px;
      }
      th,
      td {
        padding: 0.6rem 0.8rem;
        text-align: left;
        border-bottom: 1px solid var(--divider);
      }
      th {
        font-weight: 600;
        color: var(--ink-primary);
        background: var(--bg-overlay);
      }
      td {
        color: var(--ink-secondary);
      }
      tr:hover td {
        background: var(--bg-overlay);
      }

      /* 页脚 */
      .site-footer {
        text-align: center;
        padding: 1.5rem 0;
        color: var(--ink-tertiary);
        font-size: 0.82rem;
        border-top: 1px solid var(--divider);
        margin-top: 2rem;
      }

      @media (max-width: 600px) {
        .form-row {
          grid-template-columns: 1fr;
        }
        .navbar-links {
          display: none;
        }
        .palette-grid {
          grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
        }
      }
    </style>
  </head>
  <body>
    <div class="container">
      <header class="site-header">
        <h1>中式传统色彩 · 10套UI配色方案</h1>
        <p>
          基于传统色谱提取十组完整配色体系，每组包含背景色、主色、强调色、文字层级与功能状态色，可直接用于
          Web/App 界面开发。
        </p>
      </header>

      <div class="theme-switcher" id="themeSwitcher"></div>

      <section class="section">
        <h2 class="section-title">配色总览</h2>
        <div class="palette-grid" id="paletteGrid"></div>
      </section>

      <section class="section">
        <h2 class="section-title">UI 组件预览</h2>

        <div class="showcase">
          <div class="showcase-label">导航栏</div>
          <nav class="navbar">
            <div class="navbar-brand">雅集</div>
            <ul class="navbar-links">
              <li><a href="#">首页</a></li>
              <li><a href="#">作品</a></li>
              <li><a href="#">关于</a></li>
              <li><a href="#">联系</a></li>
            </ul>
          </nav>
        </div>

        <div class="showcase">
          <div class="showcase-label">排版层级</div>
          <div class="type-demo">
            <h1>主标题 · 落霞与孤鹜齐飞</h1>
            <h2>副标题 · 秋水共长天一色</h2>
            <h3>小节标题 · 传统色彩的现代演绎</h3>
            <p>
              正文内容：色彩是视觉设计的灵魂，中式传统色沉淀了千年的审美智慧。<span
                class="text-accent"
                >点缀色</span
              >为界面注入活力与焦点。
            </p>
            <p class="text-muted">次要文字：用于辅助说明、时间戳、占位提示等场景。</p>
            <p><a href="#" class="text-link">文字链接样式</a> · 悬浮时产生下划线反馈</p>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div class="showcase">
          <div class="showcase-label">按钮样式</div>
          <div class="btn-group">
            <button class="btn btn-primary">主要按钮</button>
            <button class="btn btn-secondary">次要按钮</button>
            <button class="btn btn-solid">实心按钮</button>
            <button class="btn btn-ghost">幽灵按钮</button>
          </div>
          <div class="btn-group">
            <button class="btn btn-success">成功</button>
            <button class="btn btn-warning">警告</button>
            <button class="btn btn-danger">危险</button>
            <button class="btn btn-disabled" disabled>禁用</button>
          </div>
          <div class="btn-group">
            <button class="btn btn-primary btn-sm">小</button>
            <button class="btn btn-primary">默认</button>
            <button class="btn btn-primary btn-lg">大</button>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div class="showcase">
          <div class="showcase-label">卡片组件</div>
          <div class="card-grid">
            <div class="card">
              <div class="card-title">翠微新绿</div>
              <div class="card-text">
                以绿色系为主调，营造自然清新的视觉氛围。适合生态、健康类产品。
              </div>
              <div class="card-meta"><span>自然主题</span><span>#BFD1B2</span></div>
            </div>
            <div class="card">
              <div class="card-title">东方既白</div>
              <div class="card-text">
                以蓝调清雅为基调，传递沉静与专业感。适合文化、艺术类产品。
              </div>
              <div class="card-meta"><span>清雅主题</span><span>#D3E5EF</span></div>
            </div>
            <div class="card">
              <div class="card-title">玄天黑土</div>
              <div class="card-text">深色模式设计，以大地色系为底。适合高端、沉浸式阅读体验。</div>
              <div class="card-meta"><span>暗色主题</span><span>#2E201D</span></div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div class="showcase">
          <div class="showcase-label">表单控件</div>
          <div class="form-row">
            <div class="form-group">
              <label class="form-label">用户名</label
              ><input class="form-input" placeholder="请输入用户名" />
            </div>
            <div class="form-group">
              <label class="form-label">电子邮箱</label
              ><input class="form-input" placeholder="name@example.com" />
            </div>
          </div>
          <div class="form-group">
            <label class="form-label">留言</label
            ><input class="form-input" placeholder="写下你的想法..." />
          </div>
        </div>

        <div class="showcase">
          <div class="showcase-label">标签与徽章</div>
          <div class="badge-group">
            <span class="badge badge-primary">主要</span
            ><span class="badge badge-success">成功</span
            ><span class="badge badge-warning">警告</span
            ><span class="badge badge-danger">危险</span><span class="badge badge-info">信息</span
            ><span class="badge badge-ghost">默认</span>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div class="showcase">
          <div class="showcase-label">提示消息</div>
          <div class="alert alert-success">
            <span class="alert-icon">&#10003;</span>
            <div>操作成功完成！</div>
          </div>
          <div class="alert alert-warning">
            <span class="alert-icon">&#9888;</span>
            <div>请注意：网络连接不稳定。</div>
          </div>
          <div class="alert alert-danger">
            <span class="alert-icon">&#10007;</span>
            <div>删除操作无法撤销，请确认。</div>
          </div>
          <div class="alert alert-info">
            <span class="alert-icon">&#8505;</span>
            <div>新功能上线：可批量导出配色方案。</div>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div class="showcase">
          <div class="showcase-label">分割线</div>
          <hr class="divider-line" />
          <div class="divider-label">或</div>
          <hr class="divider-dashed" />
        </div>

        <div class="showcase">
          <div class="showcase-label">数据表格</div>
          <div class="table-wrap">
            <table>
              <thead>
                <tr>
                  <th>色名</th>
                  <th>色值</th>
                  <th>用途</th>
                  <th>状态</th>
                </tr>
              </thead>
              <tbody>
                <tr>
                  <td>背景色</td>
                  <td>var(--bg-page)</td>
                  <td>页面背景</td>
                  <td><span class="badge badge-success">推荐</span></td>
                </tr>
                <tr>
                  <td>主色</td>
                  <td>var(--primary)</td>
                  <td>导航/标题</td>
                  <td><span class="badge badge-primary">主色</span></td>
                </tr>
                <tr>
                  <td>强调色</td>
                  <td>var(--accent)</td>
                  <td>按钮/CTA</td>
                  <td><span class="badge badge-warning">点缀</span></td>
                </tr>
                <tr>
                  <td>文字</td>
                  <td>var(--ink-primary)</td>
                  <td>正文内容</td>
                  <td><span class="badge badge-info">文字</span></td>
                </tr>
              </tbody>
            </table>
          </div>
        </div>
      </section>

      <footer class="site-footer"><p>中式传统色彩 · 10套UI配色方案 · 仅供设计参考</p></footer>
    </div>

    <script>
      var themes = [
        {
          key: "green",

        },
        {
          key: "ink",
          name: "墨韵书香",
          desc: "沉稳典雅",
          dot: "#131824",
          mode: "dark",
          css: {
            "--bg-page": "#131824",
            "--bg-card": "#1C2D29",
            "--bg-elevated": "#2A3F39",
            "--bg-overlay": "rgba(175,215,236,0.04)",
            "--ink-primary": "#D3E5EF",
            "--ink-secondary": "#93BDAD",

            "--primary-hover": "#AFDDE0",

            "--success": "#83AD28",

            "--warning": "#EDAC5D",

            "--danger": "#D11313",

            "--info": "#0F6B99",

            "--border": "#3A3C5B",

            "--divider": "rgba(58,60,91,0.5)",
            "--shadow-sm": "0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.2)",
            "--shadow-md": "0 4px 12px rgba(0,0,0,0.3)",
            "--shadow-lg": "0 8px 24px rgba(0,0,0,0.4)",
          },
          colors: [
            { name: "燕颌蓝", hex: "#131824", role: "页面背景" },
            { name: "老綠", hex: "#1C2D29", role: "卡片背景" },
            { name: "月白", hex: "#D3E5EF", role: "导航/标题" },
            { name: "蒼筤", hex: "#93BDAD", role: "次要/信息" },
            { name: "朱柿", hex: "#DC541B", role: "强调/按钮" },
            { name: "月白", hex: "#D3E5EF", role: "文字主色" },
            { name: "蒼筤", hex: "#93BDAD", role: "次要文字" },
            { name: "羅蘭", hex: "#3A3C5B", role: "边框/分割线" },
            { name: "柳綠", hex: "#83AD28", role: "成功状态" },
            { name: "官黄", hex: "#EDAC5D", role: "警告状态" },
            { name: "赤練紅", hex: "#D11313", role: "危险状态" },
            { name: "水色", hex: "#75878A", role: "禁用状态" },
          ],
        },
      ];

      function applyTheme(key) {
        var t = themes.find(function (x) {
          return x.key === key;
        });
        if (!t) return;
        var r = document.documentElement.style;
        Object.keys(t.css).forEach(function (k) {
          r.setProperty(k, t.css[k]);
        });
        renderPalette(t);
      }

      function renderPalette(t) {
        var g = document.getElementById("paletteGrid");
        g.innerHTML = t.colors
          .map(function (c) {
            return (
              '<div class="color-card"><div class="color-swatch" style="background:' +
              c.hex +
              '"></div><div class="color-info"><div class="color-name">' +
              c.name +
              '</div><div class="color-hex">' +
              c.hex +
              '</div><div class="color-role">' +
              c.role +
              "</div></div></div>"
            );
          })
          .join("");
      }

      (function () {
        var sw = document.getElementById("themeSwitcher");
        sw.innerHTML = themes
          .map(function (t, i) {
            return (
              '<button class="theme-btn' +
              (i === 0 ? " active" : "") +
              '" data-key="' +
              t.key +
              '"><span class="theme-dot" style="background:' +
              t.dot +
              '"></span>' +
              t.name +
              "</button>"
            );
          })
          .join("");
        sw.addEventListener("click", function (e) {
          var btn = e.target.closest(".theme-btn");
          if (!btn) return;
          sw.querySelectorAll(".theme-btn").forEach(function (b) {
            b.classList.remove("active");
          });
          btn.classList.add("active");
          applyTheme(btn.dataset.key);
        });
        applyTheme("green");
      })();
    </script>
  </body>
</html>
```
